MADE FOR KIDS: These are durably made from solid wood and safety designed rockers that are perfect for play time. These chairs are perfectly sized and weighted for children's play and they're easy to clean. Each chair is BPA-free, lead-free, and phthalate-free.

THE PERFECT GIFTS: Our chairs make great presents for any occasion! These wooden childrens lounge chairs are made out of sturdy, high-quality birch and stand up to daily play. They're the perfect thoughtful and fun gift for birthdays, Christmas, Easter, and holidays for toddlers to 8 years olds!

FAST AND EASY: These rocking chairs are simple to assemble and come with all the tools and parts you need right out of the box. Your kids will be enjoying them in no time at all! They're a perfect addition to any little boys or girls room!

THE MARK OF QUALITY: Gift Mark creates fine heirloom-quality furniture that make perfect gifts for loved ones or additions to your own home. We carefully design each piece to be easy to assemble and come together in a highly durable package you can enjoy for years to come.
description: Gift Mark: Childrens Wooden Colonial Rocking Chair (Black)

Nothing makes kids happier than when they get to have something that all the adults and big kids are using, especially when it's made just for them! Our Children's Double Slat Rocking Chair is durable enough to last a lifetime, and made safe with rounded edges in the perfect size and weight for kids! They'll love the soothing natural rocking motion. We recommend this chair for toddlers to kids about 8 years old or pre-k/kindergarten to the 4th grade (it depends a little on how big your kids are). Get real furniture for your kids that's made to last!

We include everything you need to make assembly fast and easy. Each box includes all of the parts and tools you need to put your chair together in minutes. Each chair uses real wood and is perfect for everything from reading to study time, lounge and TV time in the living room, enjoying indoors or outdoors on the porch, and much more!
